records.issue_text: contents << in TopicEmbed mutates the caller-supplied string in place, which is a latent hazard if a caller reuses or logs the original contents object after calling import
records.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import(user, url, title, contents)`, the line `contents << "\n<hr>..."` appends to the caller-provided `contents` string in place. This is verifiable from the diff and can create unintended side effects if the caller expects `contents` to remain unchanged after import (e.g., reusing/logging the same String object).
